name: NVIDIA AI Enterprise
desc: Enterprise AI software suite for data-center deployment.
desc_zh: 面向数据中心部署的企业级 AI 软件套件
solves: NIM and NeMo are components. This is the supported, licensed whole that runs them in your own data center with the compliance to match.
solves_zh: NIM 和 NeMo 只是零件。这是在你自己数据中心里跑它们的受支持、带许可的整体，配得上相应的合规。
best_for: You need self-hosted NVIDIA inference with vendor support and licensing.
best_for_zh: 你需要自托管的 NVIDIA 推理，还带厂商支持和许可。
